guidance_2026.src: Q3 2026 earnings release (Form 8-K Ex. 99.1, 22-Oct-2026), '2026 Financial Outlook' table and the business-segment-operating-profit reconciliation; prior columns from the Q4-25 (29-Jan-2026), Q1-26 (23-Apr-2026) and Q2-26 (23-Jul-2026) releases
guidance_2026.history: 29-Jan-2026: sales $77.5-80.0bn, segment OP $8,425-8,675m, FAS/CAS ~$1,365m, EPS $29.35-30.25, CFO $9,150-9,450m, capex $2.5-2.8bn, FCF $6.5-6.8bn. 23-Jul-2026: sales $79.75-81.75bn, segment OP $8,500-8,700m, EPS $29.95-30.65, CFO $9.2-9.4bn, capex $2.0-2.4bn, FCF $7.0-7.2bn; other, net ~$(490)m. 22-Oct-2026: sales ~$80-82bn, segment OP ~$8,575-8,675m, EPS ~$30.35-30.75, CFO ~$10.0-10.2bn, capex ~$2.1-2.3bn, FCF ~$7.8-8.0bn; other, net ~$(540)m. LMT does not incorporate pending acquisitions (Ultra Maritime) in its outlook.

pension_2026.src: Q3 2026 release, 'Selected Financial Data' (2026 Outlook column): FAS pension expense $(370)m; CAS pension cost $1,735m; total FAS/CAS pension adjustment $1,365m; FAS pension service cost $(50)m; FAS/CAS pension operating adjustment $1,685m; non-service FAS pension expense $(320)m. 2025 actual: FAS expense $(924)m incl. $479m settlement charge; CAS $1,568m; total $644m; service cost $(50)m; operating adjustment $1,518m; non-service $(874)m.
pension_2026.contributions: FY2025 10-K Note 11: $860m of cash contributions to the qualified plans in 2025; no required contributions expected in 2026. Estimated benefit payments: $1,760m 2026, $1,810m 2027, $1,860m 2028, $1,890m 2029, $1,920m 2030.

ultra_maritime.src: Q3 2026 10-Q Note 13 - Other: 'In July 2026, we entered into a definitive agreement to acquire Ultra Maritime Solutions (Ultra Maritime), a global defense company specializing in advanced undersea warfare and anti-submarine capabilities for allied naval forces, for $3.45 billion. Upon closing, Ultra Maritime will be reported within our RMS business segment. We expect to fund the acquisition with cash on hand. The transaction is expected to close in the fourth quarter of 2026.' No 8-K with deal terms was filed; the target is privately held and its revenue is not disclosed on EDGAR.
ultra_maritime.assumptions: Model assumptions (flagged): closing 31-Dec-2026 (no 2026 contribution); annual sales ~$900m (EV/sales ~3.8x, in line with recent defense-electronics deals; NOT DISCLOSED); segment margin 12%; PPA 40% intangibles (12-year life), 10% PP&E, remainder goodwill; no synergies assumed.

debt.src: FY2025 Form 10-K Note 10 - Debt (total debt $22,914m face at 31-Dec-2025; $21,700m net of $1,214m unamortized discounts and issuance costs; current portion $1,168m) and Q3 2026 10-Q (principal $21.7bn at 27-Sep-2026 after repaying $1,168m of notes at scheduled maturity in 2026; current maturities nil at 27-Sep-2026).
debt.ladder_note: Notes by maturity year (10-K Note 10): 3.55% due 2026 $1,000m (+$168m other notes due 2026, repaid: current maturities $1,168m at 31-Dec-2025, nil at 27-Sep-2026); 5.10% due 2027 $750m; 4.45%/4.15% due 2028 $1,000m; 4.50% due 2029 $650m; 1.85%/4.40% due 2030 $1,150m; 4.70% due 2031 $600m; 3.90% due 2032 $800m; 5.25% due 2033 $1,000m; 4.75%/4.80% due 2034 $1,450m; 3.60%/5.00% due 2035 $1,250m; later maturities $13,095m (2036-2064) plus other notes 4.85-8.50% due 2026-2041 $1,169m (allocation of the other notes by year not disclosed; model treats them as maturing after 2031 except the 2026 portion).
debt.revolver: Q3 2026 10-Q: $3.0bn 364-day revolving credit agreement (24-Aug-2026) and $3.0bn 5-year revolving credit facility extended to 24-Aug-2031; both undrawn; support commercial paper (none outstanding).
